khm.text: Tibalt arrives on Kaldheim disguised as Valki, the God of Lies, after tricking the real Valki and chaining him in King Narfi's glacial palace in Karfell.
Wearing that face he urges the troll clans to attack first, convinces King Harald that the elves must strike first, kills Koll the Forgemaster for refusing him and takes the Sword of the Realms.
Kaya blows away the illusion and reveals the devil planeswalker, but Tibalt wakes six Torga trolls to hold her off and slips away through a portal.
Using the Sword to open doorways, he unleashes Koma on Starnheim and leaves a trail through Immersturm so a planeswalker will follow.
When Kaya and Tyvar catch up, Tibalt says he has already started a Doomskar, and before they can take the Sword from him thousands of demons led by Varragoth attack another realm.
